_note: Config for components/decomposer/train_lora.py (LoRA / QLoRA fine-tuning of the decomposer on MuSiQue, issue #13) and for scripts/compare_decomposer_arms.py. Every hyperparameter of a training run lives here, so a run reproduces from a commit + this file + the seed. Nothing in this file is a measured result: the numbers are settings, not findings.

arms._note: Training-data arms. --arm selects one by key; each arm names its source (a datasets key in configs/paths.json, or an explicit path), an optional hop filter, and an optional cap. eval_hops says which hop depths of the ADR 0007 evaluation set that arm is evaluated on; the train/eval id-overlap assertion always runs against ALL of eval_set.hops regardless, so a hop-restricted arm cannot dodge it.

pool_2000._note: The 2000-example pool arm. WHICH 2000-example pool is 'the best pool' is not settled by any measured v2 result - the pool sweep has not been run in v2 - so this arm draws 2000 rows with the fixed seed from the enriched MuSiQue training pool named below, spread across hop buckets. To pin a specific pool artifact instead, set train_source_path to it (it overrides train_source_key); max_examples still applies.

full_train._note: The full MuSiQue training split, no cap and no hop filter.

generalisation_2_3hop._note: Generalisation check: train on 2-hop and 3-hop only, evaluate on 4-hop only. A model that learned the task should still decompose 4-hop questions; a model that memorised hop patterns should not.

data._note: Step text is read from the first field present, in this order: raw MuSiQue rows carry 'question_decomposition' (a list of step objects), the enriched pool carries 'few_shot_decomposition_musique' (a list of step strings written from the same source by MusiQue/scripts/enrich_pool_decompositions.py). hop_count_field is consulted when the row has one; otherwise the hop count comes from the id prefix ('2hop__', '3hop1__', '4hop2__'), falling back to the number of steps. Measured on 2026-08-18 over the 19938 rows of musique_ans_v1.0_train.jsonl: the id prefix and the step count agree on every row.

eval_set._note: The ADR 0007 MuSiQue evaluation set: 600 dev questions, 200 per hop depth, read through configs/paths.json so no path is hard-coded. These ids are what training data is asserted disjoint from.

overlap_check._note: Train/eval overlap is a hard failure, not a warning: a fine-tuned arm that saw evaluation questions is not a comparison arm. max_reported_ids caps how many offending ids the error message prints.

prompt._note: The training prompt is built from the SAME per-model prompt file the prompting arm uses (components/decomposer/models/<model>/), with the few-shot block empty: the fine-tuned arm is meant to answer zero-shot, and inference must see the string shape training saw (run_decomposer.py --adapter ... --no-few-shot). target_reference_style 'as_is' trains on the gold step text verbatim; 'bracketed' rewrites '#1' to '[#1]' to match the convention the prompt file states. The choice is not neutral and is Jahid's to make: the evaluator strips brackets before matching steps (so exact-match and step-F1 are unaffected), but reference_validity_micro is vacuously 1.0 for predictions with no [#k] references, and ROUGE-L tokenises before punctuation stripping, so '#1' and '[#1]' are different tokens there.
prompt._unguided_hop_placeholder_note: Not duplicated here: it is read from decomposer_config below, so the training prompt and the inference prompt cannot drift apart on it.

loader._note: Base-model loading for training. QLoRA is the 4bit path (bitsandbytes NF4 + double quantization); 'none' loads in dtype. device_map 'auto' needs accelerate.

lora._note: target_modules are the attention/MLP projection names of Llama/Mistral-family models. A different base architecture uses different names, so this list is a config value, not a default buried in code; peft raises if a name is absent.

training._note: trl SFTConfig fields. The dataset is prompt/completion typed and completion_only_loss masks the prompt out of the loss, so the model is trained on the decomposition text only. Batch 1 x grad-accum 16 with gradient checkpointing and max_length 1024 is what keeps a 4-bit 7B base inside 24 GiB on the RTX 3090 of docs/compute.md - an estimate until a run measures peak_gpu_memory_bytes, which the metrics JSON records. bf16 is supported on Ampere.
training._warmup_note: warmup_steps, not warmup_ratio: transformers 5.5.4 warns that warmup_ratio is deprecated and slated for removal, so the run would emit a deprecation warning and eventually break.

evaluation._note: scripts/compare_decomposer_arms.py. Quality comes only from scripts/musique_decompositions_evaluator.py - string-level metrics, no model in the loop and never a commercial API rating decompositions (CLAUDE.md standing constraint). Cost comes from the 'cost' block each decomposer run writes into its own metrics.json. quality_keys and cost_keys are the columns of the summary table.
